content.title: XO, Kitty Season 3 Trailer: Watch Now
content.text: XO, Kitty Season 3 Trailer: Watch Now - Netflix TudumXO, Kitty Season 3 Trailer: Check Off Kitty’s Senior Sunset ListKitty Song Covey (Anna Cathcart) has her whole senior year at KISS mapped out in the trailer for XO, Kitty Season 3. Coming April 2, the season follows Kitty as she endeavors to check everything off her Senior Sunset list with the help of her pals Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee), Dae (Minyeong Choi), Yuri (Gia Kim), and Q (Anthony Keyvan), of course.She needs to figure out where she wants to apply to college, have a traditional Chuseok meal with her Korean family, and, most pressingly, define the simmering feelings she and Min Ho have been harboring for years.Like any little sister would in a time of crisis, Kitty calls her big sis Lara Jean (Lana Condor), who we all remember fondly as the star of To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before. “Whatever happens with Min Ho, we can’t just stop living our lives,” LJ reminds her baby sis in the trailer. “We have to follow our hearts and trust that it will lead us to our next great adventure.”Keep up with all the adventures in the new season of XO, Kitty, premiering April 2 on Netflix.March 9VideoRelated VideosBloopersIt’s impossible not to smile while watching.Behind the Scenes“It feels crazy to return to the role of Lara Jean after all these years.”BloopersBlue tongues, dance breaks, and more!Behind the ScenesReunited, and it feels Seoul good.TrailerNew year, same Kitty.
